event_name: Time 17:13 2018 ABU DHABI GRAND PRIX 22 - 25 November The Stewards have conducted the Hearing of the Protest lodged by Haas F1 Team against Racing Point Force India F1 Team Cars 11 & 31. A substantial amount of written evidence was submitted and each party made extensive verbal representation. The Stewards are deliberating on the matter. It is anticipated that a Decision will not be handed down any earlier that just prior to Free Practice 3.
